rendering.allyScaleRule: displayAllyBodyHeight * slot.bodyScale / slot.bodyHeight; bodyHeight is standing reference, unchanged across action switches
rendering.screenSpaceOutline: Optional single 1px non-blurred alpha silhouette pass AFTER final sizing, with no changed PNG. Do not stack a second heavy raster border. Exact continuous white outline at noninteger downscale remains runtime QA.
rendering.fixedPoseRendering: preserve ground world anchor through pose/form changes; never auto-fit alpha bbox or force all sprites equal-height
rendering.fx: Only independent translations, flashes, particles or positive-scale effects; never transform scaleX(-1) or mirror asymmetrical characters.
